text: Status check ahead of next week's go/no-go. Everything green except ATL-212. <@U07DEVON> where are we?

ACS and JIT provisioning work. But assertions intermittently fail signature validation: KeyGate's SAML metadata endpoint sometimes serves a signing cert that doesn't match what signed the response. Opened a case with Victor at KeyGate.
Can we pin the cert instead of refreshing from metadata?
Tried. Breaks the moment KeyGate rotates, and Globex's security review explicitly rejects pinned certs. Need KeyGate to fix metadata.
Onboarding flow v3 is merged. Setup time for a new site in staging went from ~25 min to 9 min.
